kpis.description_en: Materials Group (LGM) = ~80% of AVY revenue (pressure-sensitive labels, graphics, films). Global leader.

kpis.description_fr: Solutions Group = RFID + Intelligent Labels + Apparel branding. Croissance forte tirée par adoption RFID retail (Inditex, Walmart, Macy's).
kpis.description_en: Solutions Group = RFID + Intelligent Labels + Apparel branding. Strong growth from retail RFID adoption (Inditex, Walmart, Macy's).

kpis.description_en: Intelligent Labels (UHF RFID) = AVY's star engine. ~80% global market share. Massive Inditex/Walmart/Macy's adoption over 5 years.

kpis.description_fr: Mix produit avec contenu recyclé / bio-sourcé en croissance. Différentiation ESG critique pour FMCG (Unilever, P&G, L'Oréal).
kpis.description_en: Mix of products with recycled/bio content growing. Critical ESG differentiation for FMCG customers (Unilever, P&G, L'Oréal).

kpis.description_en: 75% of revenue outside USA, well diversified Europe + Asia. FX and global market exposure.
